text.content:
An Elementalist has learned to channel the souls that flow within the basic elements of creation: Air, Earth, Fire and Water.

SKILLS

ELEMENTAL MAGIC · SL max 10

Each time you acquire this Skill, learn one Elementalist spell. Offensive spells use (INS + WLP) for the Magic Check.

CATACLYSM · SL max 3

When you cast a spell with a duration of "Instantaneous", if you have an arcane weapon equipped, you may increase the spell's total MP cost by up to (SL × 10) Mind Points. If you do so, the spell deals 5 extra damage for every 10 Mind Points by which you increased its cost this way.

MAGICAL ARTILLERY · SL max 3

When you cast an offensive spell (O), if you have an arcane weapon equipped, you gain a bonus to your Magic Check equal to (SL × 2).

SPELLBLADE · SL max 3

When you cast an offensive spell (O) targeting a single creature, if the spell has a total Mind Point cost of (SL × 20) or lower, you may choose one non-arcane weapon you have equipped. If you do, your Magic Check for the spell uses the chosen weapon's Accuracy Check formula; if that formula includes Dexterity, the Magic Check also gains a bonus equal to (SL).

RITUAL SCROLLS · SL max 3

When performing a Ritual, you may pay an additional 10 MP to store it in a scroll instead of resolving it on the spot. You can hold up to (SL) scrolls at a time. Whoever is holding a scroll may release it for 10 MP; if released in conflict, this takes an action and runs its Clock as a normal Ritual would. A scroll is destroyed when used.

MOTE OF CREATION · SL max 3

When you rest, you may welcome a spark of one element — Air, Earth, Fire or Water — into your spirit. Once before your next rest you may spend that spark to bolster yourself: Air (replace one DEX or INS die value for a non-Accuracy, non-Magic Check with SL + 2), Earth (reduce Hit Point or Mind Point loss by SL × 4), Fire (reduce an Inventory Point cost by SL), or Water (reduce a travel roll result by SL, minimum 1).

SPELLS

INSULATING JACKET · 5 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Scene

You weave magical energy and protect the targets from the fury of the elements. Choose a damage type: air, bolt, earth, fire or ice. Until this spell ends, each target gains Resistance to the chosen damage type.

THE TARRANT GLIDE · 10 MP · Self · Scene

Until this spell ends, you treat your Dexterity as if it were one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12). At the end of the round, if you are under the effects of this spell, you must perform up to two free attacks, dealing extra damage equal to half your current Dexterity die size. If you perform only one attack, it gains multi (2); if you perform two attacks, both attacks follow the rules for two-weapon fighting (see Core Rulebook, page 69). This spell ends after all the attacks are resolved.

THE FENWICK TEMPER · 10 MP · One equipped weapon · Scene

You imbue a weapon with elemental energy. Choose a damage type: air, bolt, earth, fire, or ice. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes of the chosen damage type. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action. This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.

BALLISTIC EXTENSION · 10 MP · Self · Instantaneous

The wind carries your strikes across the battlefield. You may perform a free attack with a melee weapon you have equipped; this attack may target creatures that cannot normally be targeted by melee attacks. If you used a weapon belonging to the brawling, spear, or sword Category for this attack, it deals 5 extra damage. If you hit a flying target with this attack, you may force them to land immediately.

FULGUR [Z] · 10 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Instantaneous

You weave electricity into a wave of crackling bolts. You deal (HR + 15) bolt damage to each target hit by this spell. Opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers dazed.

GLACIES [Z] · 10 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Instantaneous

You coat your foes under a thick layer of frost. You deal (HR + 15) ice damage to each target hit by this spell. Opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers slow.

IGNIS [Z] · 10 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Instantaneous

You unleash a searing barrage against your foes, conjuring flames out of thin air. You deal (HR + 15) fire damage to each target hit by this spell. Opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers shaken.

TERRA [Z] · 10 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Instantaneous

Spires of jagged rock erupt from the ground beneath your foes, closing around them. You deal (HR + 15) earth damage to each target hit by this spell. This spell cannot target creatures that are flying, floating, falling, or otherwise in mid-air. Opportunity: each target hit by this spell performs one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).

VENTUS [Z] · 10 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Instantaneous

You summon the power of winds against your enemy. You deal (HR + 15) air damage to each target hit by this spell. Opportunity: each flying target hit by this spell is forced to land immediately.

CONCUSSION [Z] · 20 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You summon a colossal block of stone and send it straight towards your enemy. You deal (HR + 25) earth damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.

INCANDESCENCE [Z] · 20 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You channel a single ray of fire towards your foe, its temperature so high that it will pierce through most defenses. You deal (HR + 25) fire damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.

CONGELATION [Z] · 20 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

A pillar of ice magic envelops your foe, dropping their temperature to critical levels. You deal (HR + 25) ice damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.

LEYDEN DISCHARGE [Z] · 20 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You send an arrow of overcharged lightning to strike your foe. You deal (HR + 25) bolt damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.

RAREFACTION [Z] · 20 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You slash through your foe with high-pressure wind. You deal (HR + 25) air damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.

PYROCLASTIC COLUMN · 40 MP · Special · Instantaneous

You channel the fury of the planet into a powerful wave of fire and magma. Choose one option: you deal 50 fire damage to one enemy you can see; or you deal 30 fire damage to every enemy you can see. These amounts increase by 5 if you are level 20 or higher, or by 10 if you are level 40 or higher. Damage dealt by this spell ignores Resistances and Immunities.

EFFLUVIA [Z] · 20 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You manipulate the elemental balance within the target's body. You deal (HR + 30) poison damage to the target, and this damage ignores Resistances. Then, if the High Roll of the Magic Check was 8 or higher, or if you have acquired the Pathogenesis Skill (Core Rulebook, page 183), the target suffers poisoned.
